topic: avoid lap marks when painting a large wall
core_question: How do you prevent streaky lap marks from showing when rolling paint on a large wall?
answer_summary: Work in manageable sections and keep a 'wet edge,' overlapping into still-wet paint before it starts to dry, rather than letting edges set before the next stroke.
persona: polite but increasingly frustrated; writing terse one-liners

messages.content: I've been rolling paint on my living room wall and keep ending up with these streaky marks where I overlap the sections. Ruining the whole look. What causes that?
